title: The Launch Gantry
summary: Routes to other worlds need a Launch Gantry, unlocked by the research Orbital Launch.
text:
Travel on your own world goes overland from the Command Core. Reaching **other worlds** of the star system takes a shuttle.

The research **Orbital Launch** (in Economy, after Isotope Cells) unlocks the **Launch Gantry**: a lattice tower with a shuttle on its rail. It can't be researched until the end of Act 1. The gantry is big, takes a while to build and costs isotopes as well as alloys.

Once it stands, select it: its **LAUNCH** list shows every route to another world. Tap one, then tap again to be sure, and the camera pulls out to the star system as you go.

Off-world regions are expeditions like any other: each keeps its own save, and you can always come home.
